Our doors are open to the community offering football pitch hire for all on 5 and 7-a-side arenas, kid's parties, corporate events, functions, and hall hire. Football is a great way to have fun and get fit and with our artificial surface, ProTurf®, you'll be playing as close to grass as you can be. It's designed specifically for small-sided football, and completely exclusive to GOALS delivering natural gameplay, pace, and is easier on your joints allowing you to play for longer. Choose a casual pitch booking for game time with no commitment, playing when you like, as often as you like. Dedicated baller? We've got you covered with a block booking. Secure the same pitch at the same time every week with zero upfront cost, simply pay as normal every week. You'll also be eligible for loyalty vouchers that can be used to pay for those post-match pints in our players' lounge. Play football, get fit, feel good. Join our professional-run football leagues with dedicated league managers, committed teams of all abilities, GOALS referees, and great winner's prizes are up for grabs! So… How does it work? Simply get your team together and play a trial game at a reduced cost; this is where you get a taste of the GOALS League experience. We then evaluate your team's ability before allocating you to an appropriate, competitive division. Are you game? Tap below to kick off. TRIAL MATCH KID'S COACHING Group coaching classes are a fun way for kids to learn the beautiful game. Pay-as-you-go training at just £8 per session means you simply turn up and train, no advance commitment or booking is required. Alternatively, you can purchase a 10-week Block Booking for £72. Parents can drop off and go, watch from the sideline, or take comfort in our Café. Sessions available for 5 – 12 year olds: Tuesday: 5:30pm – 7pm Thursday: 5:30pm – 7pm Saturday: 9:30am – 11am Start your child's football journey, or take their training to the next level, below. Book PLANNING A PARTY? An in-house dedicated events team is on hand to help with catering, decorations, and music options, leaving you free to relax and enjoy your occasion. Our modern function suite is available on selected weekdays, Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays. Our hall holds up to 150 people so you won't need to compromise on your guestlist, available for as little as a refundable £100 deposit. A late license is available on request so you and your guests can party into midnight. Hall hire, meeting room, event hire, weddings, engagement, retirement, or milestone birthdays such as 18ths, we can look after you, whatever your event. Get in touch below and let us take care of the rest. ENQUIRE KICKABOUT Maybe you're not a planner, after a casual Kickabout with a few friends or, you're a parent trying to keep your children active; our Kickabout sessions are a flexible way to level up. Pitches are available from the early morning right through to late night sessions on fully enclosed arenas for only £6 per player on 5-a-side and £8 per player on 7-a-side. Stay fit with your friends Play when it suits you 1 hour pitch time guaranteed No booking required No commitment Simply get your mates together, hit the pitch, and play football. *Pitch exclusivity isn't guaranteed, this is subject to pitch availability. KIDS FOOTBALL PARTIES Enjoy an unforgettable kids party at GOALS whatever the weather, on our outdoor all-weather ProTurf pitches. Whether you choose our Premier Party or prefer to Build Your Own, your little football star is guaranteed a day to remember. Parties are priced based on a minimum of 10 children, with the option to add more guests for an additional cost – either when booking or closer to the big day. Every party takes place in a fun, safe and fully supervised environment, giving you peace of mind while the kids enjoy non-stop football action. And that's just the start – from Panini goodies and party bags to trophies, medals, and tasty upgrades like pizza, ice cream and slushies, there are loads of ways to make their big day even more unforgettable.
